PRODUCTS / PARKINSON’S CARE

PARKINSON’S CARE

Supporting movement. Encouraging rehabilitation.

Parkinson’s can affect movement, balance and everyday physical activity. Neuro Mates is designed to support movement monitoring and make rehabilitation more engaging through interactive exercises.

Register for a demo →See how it works ↓

MOVEMENT MONITORING

Movement monitoring

A lightweight wearable worn on the back of the hand uses motion sensors to continuously collect movement data. Real-time analysis can identify abnormal conditions such as hand tremors or falls.

Tremor and motion trackingLightweight wearableSecure, ergonomic fitStatus light

EMERGENCY RESPONSE

When something is wrong, the family knows.

When abnormal activity is detected, a WhatsApp alert can be sent to the family and an emergency siren can be activated through the speaker. The patient can also raise an alert with a manual emergency switch. The system continues checking the patient’s condition. When the condition returns to normal, a recovery/safe confirmation can be sent and monitoring resumes.

ILLUSTRATION, NOT REAL PATIENT DATA
1 Normal movement2 Abnormal movement detected3 Alert sent to family, siren activated4 Condition returns to normal5 Safe confirmation sent, monitoring resumes

ALERT AND RECOVERY

The family is told, then told it is safe.

A WhatsApp alert can be sent to the family when abnormal activity is detected. When the condition returns to normal, a recovery/safe confirmation can be sent and monitoring resumes.

INTERACTIVE REHABILITATION

Rehabilitation that feels like play.

Interactive exercises can use facial expressions, hand movement, finger movement, leg movement and joint movement. The patient performs condition-appropriate exercises and movement activities through an interactive experience.

Explore interactive rehabilitation →

WHO SEES WHAT

Four portals, one product.

Technology: Motion sensing, movement monitoring, AI and machine-learning analysis, IoT communication and a connected care platform.

PRODUCTS / ALZHEIMER’S CARE

ALZHEIMER’S CARE

Supporting memory, routine and patient safety.

Neuro Mates Alzheimer’s Care combines daily activity tracking, personalised memory-recall activities, medication support and location-based safety monitoring to support patients and their families.

Register for a demo →See how it works ↓

DAILY ACTIVITY RECORDING

A clear view of the daily routine.

Patients can record daily activities from 8 AM to 10 PM at two-hour intervals, creating a structured view of their daily routine.

8 AMBreakfast
10 AMMedicine
12 PM
2 PMWalking
4 PM
6 PM
8 PM
10 PM

Examples: Breakfast · Medicine · Walking

Memory recall

The system can use recorded activities to create related memory-recall questions for the following day.

Personalised memories

Family members can upload photographs of loved ones, friends or relatives. The system can use these photographs to create personalised memory questions.

LIVE MEMORY QUIZ

Try a daily memory check-in.

A daily memory check-in works as a real interaction. Choose an answer to see how the quiz responds.

SAMPLE QUESTION, ILLUSTRATION

Which of these did you have for breakfast today?

MEDICATION SUPPORT

Medication support

Medication reminders help patients maintain their daily routine. Family members can be alerted about missed activities.

LOCATION SAFETY

Location safety

A location tracker provides continuous patient location tracking. An administrator defines the safe zone. The current approved safe-zone concept uses a 1 km radius. When the patient moves outside the defined safe zone, the system can generate an alert and contact the administrator. The administrator can see the current distance from the safe zone in meters or kilometres.

Drag the patient dot across the boundary.

ILLUSTRATION

WHO SEES WHAT

Four portals, one product.

Technology: Location tracking, safe-zone monitoring, connected platform, daily activity data and personalised memory-recall logic.

PRODUCTS / EPILEPSY CARE

EPILEPSY CARE

Helping families stay connected during epilepsy monitoring.

The Neuro Mates epilepsy monitoring system continuously observes brain activity and connects abnormal EEG activity with immediate family alerts, emergency response and continued monitoring.

Register for a demo →See how it works ↓

CONTINUOUS MONITORING

Continuous monitoring

A lightweight headband with a brain-signal sensor continuously monitors the patient’s brain activity. A reference electrode sits behind the ear. The EEG view can show Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta and Theta waves.

Responsible wording. Neuro Mates monitors for abnormal EEG signals that may indicate a seizure. It does not diagnose, predict or prevent seizures, and detection cannot be guaranteed.

PRODUCTS / PARALYSIS CARE

PARALYSIS CARE

Making rehabilitation more engaging.

Neuro Mates Paralysis Care uses interactive, game-based rehabilitation activities to encourage patients to perform prescribed exercises using different areas of the body.

Register for a demo →See how it works ↓

REHABILITATION AREAS

Exercise with different parts of the body.

How the exercise is read. Skin electrodes and muscle-signal sensors pick up the electrical activity of a muscle, and brain signals and facial expressions can also be used. These signals control the game, and the screen shows the patient’s repetitions and session progress.

TRY THE IDEA

Contract the muscle, move the game.

ILLUSTRATION, NOT A MEDICAL TOOL

Repetitions: 0/15

MAIN MESSAGE

Instead of limiting rehabilitation to fixed therapy sessions, Neuro Mates aims to give patients an engaging way to practise exercises at their own pace.

WHO SEES WHAT

Four portals, one product.

Technology: Muscle-signal sensing, game-based interactive activities and a connected care platform.
